#organisational variable workflow


#Your company has 20 microservice repositories under one GitHub organization.
#All services are deployed to AWS Mumbai region.

#Common value
#AWS_REGION = ap-south-1


#Instead of defining this in every repo…

# Without organization-level variable

#You define AWS_REGION separately in:

#repo-1

#repo-2

#repo-3

#repo-20

#⚠️ Problems:

#Duplicate configuration

#Risk of mismatch

#Hard to change later

#✅ With organization-level variable (best practice)

#You define once at organization level:

#GitHub → Organization → Settings → Variables

#AWS_REGION = ap-south-1


#Now all repositories can use it.

#Benefits:
#Single source of truth
#Easier maintenance
#Reduced risk of errors
#Simplified configuration

#To use organization-level variables in your workflows, you can reference them just like other environment variables.
#Environment variables override repository variables, and repository variables override organization variables.
